data.title: 冰堂美智留 · 地下Livehouse的吉他Solo狂飙
data.description: 烟雾缭绕的地下摇滚Livehouse舞台正中，彩色频闪聚光灯交错撕裂黑暗。美智留肩挎电吉他屈膝后仰狂飙吉他Solo，汗珠顺着锁骨飞溅，撕边牛仔裤尽显摇滚少女狂放野性。
data.location: dim underground rock concert livehouse stage filled with theatrical fog and colored laser lights
data.action: shredding an electric guitar with fierce rock posture, arching back, sweat glistening on bare collarbones, wild ecstatic musician smile
data.lighting: 舞台各色频闪聚光射灯与烟雾背光
data.promptProse: Michiru shreds a blazing guitar solo under strobe lights on a smoke-filled Livehouse stage, wild ecstasy radiating through her rock performance.
data.animaCaption: Stage laser lights pierce through the smoke haze as sweat flies from her furious guitar strumming.
